node.statement: The multiplication map mu_C1 is smooth relative to calM_delta. The restricted ambient bilinear map b:calM_delta x calM_delta -> calX is smooth by 1.3 and has image in the open set S_delta by the membership antecedent. Hence it is smooth as an S_delta-valued map; composing it with the stipulated smooth first polar-inverse component u_delta:S_delta -> calM_delta gives (U,V) |-> u_delta(U bold-dot V)=mu_C1(U,V).
